results.name: the statements show the composed figures (total assets 33,000.00; profit 5,100.00) and the next action names the comparatives as a reviewer's step
keyboard: arrow keys move through the rows, Enter opens the lineage panel (accounts, certification, assignment), Escape closes it and returns focus
notes: every requirement with the server's status; recording wording through the form is accepted by the server
schedules: the property, plant and equipment schedule is reconciled to the statements by the server
a preparer cannot approve (no control; the next action says it is a reviewer's)
the reviewer approves through the confirmation (reason required); the server's state becomes Approved
the next action asks for the cash-flow and equity evidence on the Statements page, in readable words
six evidence files are validated in the browser and shown as not stored; one save stores them with version 1 and re-saves version 2; each file then shows as in version 2, which has no blocker
a preparer cannot sign: no sign-off control, the page says who does
the reviewer marks version 2 REVIEWED (confirmation with reason)
the owner approves version 2 as FINAL; the version is sealed
the FINAL pack carries the seal with the recorded approver, the server binding's hashes and the composed figures; printed to PDF
printing the Exports PAGE yields only the sealed pack, in full: no navigation, controls or next action; the page PDF has the pack's page count
leaving Exports removes the print host: printing any other page is unaffected
the draft (version 1) renders through the same pack with the DRAFT watermark; printed to PDF
context is preserved: navigating from Exports v2 to Statements keeps v=2 on the link
a later change: the signed version stays FINAL but the next action asks for a new version and names the stale dependency
a viewer sees the statements but has no write control anywhere on the sign-off page
another workspace's owner is refused by the server; the page shows the error with a retry, not data
every data request of every page stayed on loopback (the app stylesheet's web font is the only other host)
